user.title: Add an IR light
user.description: Choose the BroadLink remote that can reach this light. Learn both power buttons before saving. Brightness steps is the number of button presses from minimum to maximum.

init.title: Device settings
init.description: Rename or recalibrate this device, then learn or replace individual commands. The BroadLink remote is fixed to preserve its learned commands.

settings.title: IR commands
settings.description: Learn, test, or remove commands. Power on and power off are required; colors, effects, and brightness are optional.

learn.title: Learn a button
learn.description: Select its function. For a color or effect, provide a name; select RGB only for a color preset. Press Submit, then point the physical remote at BroadLink and press the button when prompted. After learning, the new command is sent once automatically so you can verify the response.

learned.title: Button learned
learned.description: The new button was sent once. Confirm that the physical device responded correctly to keep the mapping. If not, cancel and retry learning.

finish.title: Power buttons required
finish.description: Learn both Power on and Power off before saving. Continue to return to the command menu.

remove.title: Remove a mapping
remove.description: Only the mapping is removed. The original learned code remains in BroadLink storage.

test.title: Test a button
test.description: This sends a real IR command. Check that the device responds, then return to the menu.

error.learn_failed: Learning failed or timed out. Continue to retry.
error.test_failed: The command could not be sent. Check the remote and retry.
error.no_commands: Learn a button first. Continue to return to the menu.
error.missing_power: Learn Power on and Power off before saving.
error.not_confirmed: Confirm the physical response, or cancel and retry learning.

progress.learning: Point the physical remote at BroadLink and press the chosen button. Learning times out after 30 seconds.
